Title: Zebronics Foldable Mobile & Tablet Stand, Multi-Angle Adjustable, Supports Up to 30.48cm Devices, Lightweight & Portable Design (MTS30)
Brand: ZEBRONICS
Highlights:
- FOLDABLE DESIGN: Smart foldable structure allows easy storage and portability, making it perfect for travel, office, or home use.
- WIDE DEVICE COMPATIBILITY: Compatible with both mobile phones and tablets, supporting devices up to 30.48cm screen size.
- MULTI-ANGLE ADJUSTMENT: Easily adjust the viewing angle for comfortable video calls, streaming, reading, or browsing.
- LIGHTWEIGHT & PORTABLE: Compact and lightweight build makes it easy to carry in bags or pockets for on-the-go convenience.

Title: Portronics MODESK Universal Mobile Holder Stand with Metal Body, Anti Skid Design, Light Weight for All Smartphones, Tablets, Kindle, iPad(Black)
Brand: Portronics
Highlights:
- MoDesk - a Premium Quality Mobile Holders for your Ofﬁce Desks. It can hold, on your work desk, any type of smartphone & tablets with size up to 7 inches easily
- MoDesk is a Aluminum + ABS metallic body desk mobile holders which is rust and corrosion proof
- It has angular design which gives perfect viewing angle of your smartphone on the desk so you can easily and privately see incoming calls, respond to messages without the risk of prying eyes
- The antiskid silicon pads on the body prevents accidental slips and protection from scratches
- For any issue Email customer support help@portronics.com
